description: Respond using your private receipt_id. confirm_scope or correct_scope requires a proposed scope; correct_scope, for an Answer only, also requires correction text (for a Brief or Map, send a changed question as a new request). accept_quote or decline_quote requires an unexpired quote; decline_quote may include a budget counter-offer. Acceptance records your choice of offer: no work starts and nothing is owed until payment. Use check_research_status before responding. Do not include contact details or personal information in a correction.

action.description: confirm_scope or correct_scope answers a proposed scope; accept_quote or decline_quote answers an unexpired quote.

budget.description: For decline_quote: an optional counter-offer, in minor units (cents) with a three-letter currency code.

correction.description: For correct_scope on an Answer: what to change in the proposed scope, 1 to 2,000 characters.

receipt_id.description: The receipt_id that submit_research_interest returned. Keep it private.

name: respond_to_research_offer
title: Respond to SNTL's offer
